title: Describe
description: What this `ersatztv-channel` binary supports, printed by `ersatztv-channel describe`.

binary.description: The binary that produced this document.

contract.description: Schema versions, output files and timing that integrators depend on.

describe_version.description:
Version of this document. Fields may be added without a bump; removing, renaming or
changing the meaning of a field bumps it.

runtime_capability.description:
What this machine and the config's ffmpeg build can do, from `describe --probe <config>`;
`null` without `--probe`.

schema_capability.description:
Values the channel config accepts. A value listed here may still be unavailable on this
machine or ffmpeg build.

configured.description: Whether this is the accel, device and driver the channel config selects.

decode.description:
Source codecs the channel decodes in hardware. Each codec was checked with a typical profile
for each pixel format; a stream's actual profile or interlacing can still make it decode in
software. A codec or pixel format not listed decodes in software.

device.description:
The device probed: the VAAPI render node, or the AMF adapter (`<index>: <description>`, or
the configured index when the probe failed). `null` for other accels.

driver.description:
The VAAPI driver probed, as a `normalization.video.vaapi_driver` value; `null` when libva
selected it, and for other accels.

encode.description:
`normalization.video.format` values the channel encodes in hardware, by
`normalization.video.bit_depth`. Anything not listed encodes in software.

error.description: Why the accel isn't available, or `null`.

status.description:
Whether the channel can use this accel. `decode` and `encode` are empty unless it is
`available`.

AccelStatus.title: AccelStatus
AccelStatus.description:
`available`: the channel uses this accel. `ffmpeg_missing`: the ffmpeg build lacks its hwaccel,
so the channel uses software. `probe_failed`: the device or driver couldn't be opened (see
`error`). `timeout`: the probe didn't finish. `skipped`: not probed, because an earlier probe of
the same accel didn't finish.

commit.description: Full git commit hash, or `null` when the build didn't record one.

version.description: Release version, e.g. `0.2.4+x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, or `<version>+local` for local builds.

channel_config_schema.description:
Channel config schema version. Configs and overlays load when their `breaking` matches and
their `compatible` is not newer.

dynamic_callback_headers.description:
Headers sent on every dynamic source request. `DynamicSource` in the playout schema
defines them.

output_files.description: Files written to the channel's output folder.

playout_schema.description:
Playout schema version. Playout files load when their `breaking` matches and their
`compatible` is not newer.

segment_seconds.description: Target HLS segment length in seconds.

format.description: Codec name as ffprobe reports it (`codec_name`), e.g. `hevc`.

pixel_formats.description: Pixel formats as ffprobe reports them (`pix_fmt`), e.g. `yuv420p10le`.

hwaccels.description: Hardware accels the ffmpeg build lists (`ffmpeg -hwaccels`).

path.description: Path from the channel config, or `ffmpeg` (found on `PATH`) when it sets none.

version.description: Version from `ffmpeg -version`, e.g. `n8.1.2-etv.4`, or `null` when it couldn't be read.

heartbeat.description:
Touched by the integrator while it still wants the channel; the channel stops when it goes
stale.

playlist.description: HLS media playlist for the channel.

ready.description: Created once the playlist is ready to serve.

subtitle_playlist.description: WebVTT subtitle playlist, written when subtitles are converted.

RuntimeCapability.title: RuntimeCapability
RuntimeCapability.description: What this machine and ffmpeg build can do with a channel config.

accels.description:
One entry per probe of every accel this build can probe here, selected or not. VAAPI appears
once per render node and driver; the others once. `configured` marks the config's entry.

ffmpeg.description: The ffmpeg build the channel config selects.

compatible.description: Compatible digit; documents with this value or lower load.

uri.description: Newest version URI this binary accepts, as written in a document's `version`.
